description: A white AirPods charging case and a white charging cable with a Lightning tip are on the bed in front of the hands. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up and steady the right-hand object (the AirPods case), while the left hand holds the left-hand object (the cable tip) and guides it rightward into the case’s charging port, then slightly pulls the cable back out as the right hand keeps the case in place.
